reply.text: I'm sorry that comment stung. If you want to talk through what he said, I'm happy to hear it, and I'd like to know what was said before I weigh in on it. For today, let's look at what's on your plan and what you've trained lately so we pick something that fits how you're feeling. Give me a sec to pull up your program. Nothing shows up in your program or your workouts from the last week, so I don't have a session to point you to yet. That's fine. Tell me what equipment you have and roughly how much time you've got, and I'll help you pick a sensible session. And if you want to tell me what your trainer said, I'm listening.
